Greetings, **RozRaid**! Welcome back. Based on your current progression, recent achievements (hitting Level 106 Necromancy and completing *Tomes of the Warlock*), and your overarching goals, here is a detailed, tactical master plan tailored to your profile.

---

### 📊 Account Snapshot & Key Metric Breakdown

| Skill / Metric | Current Level / Value | Target / Goal | Progress Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Necromancy** | Level 106 (28,220,818 XP) | Level 120 (104,273,167 XP) | 27.0% Total XP |
| **Combat Level** | 134 | Max Combat | Endgame Ready |
| **Slayer** | Level 95 | 99 / 120 Slayer | High Synergy with Necro |
| **Invention** | Level 48 | Level 99+ (Perks) | Priority Secondary Focus |
| **Quests** | 240 Completed | Necro Questline Finished | Final Quests Remaining |

---

### 🎯 Strategic Plan: Active To-Do List & Goals

#### 1. Path to 120 Necromancy
You are currently Level 106 with over 28M XP. To reach Level 120, you need an additional **~76.05M XP**. 

* **Ritual Route (Fastest XP & Active Ink Conversion)**:
  * Utilize [Powerful Commune III](https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerful_Commune_III) or high-level rituals equipped with maxed **Multiply Glyphs** (Multiply III / IV) for maximum disturbance events.
  * Focus on completing all random disturbance events (Defiled Souls, Wandering Souls, Corrupt Glyphs) as they yield the vast majority of ritual XP per hour. Refer to the [Necromancy Training Guide](https://runescape.wiki/w/Pay-to-play_Necromancy_training) for exact tile positioning.
* **Combat Route (AFK / Gold Generation)**:
  * **Abyssal Beasts / Armor Zombies**: Great AFK combat XP while leveling gear for [Invention](https://runescape.wiki/w/Invention) divine components.
  * **Hermod / Rasial**: Excellent for unique drops, combat experience, and upgrading your gear tier.

---

#### 2. Necromancy Quests & Upgrade Completion
You have already completed the core questline up to *Tomes of the Warlock* and *Soul Searching*. 

* **Final Quest Milestone**: Ensure you have completed [Alpha and Omega](https://runescape.wiki/w/Alpha_and_Omega) to cap off the primary storyline and unlock high-tier combat rewards.
* **Kili's Upgrades**: Complete any outstanding [Kili's Knowledge](https://runescape.wiki/w/Kili%27s_Knowledge) tasks to fully unlock Tier 90 Power/Tank Necromancy equipment if you haven't already done so.

---

#### 3. Converting Necroplasm to Powerful Necroplasm
To sustainably feed your high-tier ritual inks ([Powerful Ink](https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerful_ink)) and complete your goal of converting lower-tier necroplasms:

* **Conversion Rituals**: Run [Necroplasm Purification](https://runescape.wiki/w/Lesser_Necroplasm_Purification) rituals at the [Ritual Site](https://runescape.wiki/w/Ritual_site).
* **Glyph Optimization**: Stack **Multiply Glyphs** to increase your output ratio per ritual cycle (turning 100 Lesser into significantly higher yield Greater/Powerful necroplasm yields).
* **Inks Required**: Keep a healthy stock of [Greater Ink](https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_ink) on hand to continuously advance materials to [Powerful Necroplasm](https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerful_necroplasm).

---

### 🦅 Tactical Bossing Focus: Kree'arra

Necromancy provides an extremely smooth and efficient kill strategy against [Kree'arra](https://runescape.wiki/w/Kree%27arra) in the Armadyl Citadel.

* **Slayer Synergy**: Stack your [Full Slayer Helmet](https://runescape.wiki/w/Full_slayer_helmet) with an active **Aviansie** or **Boss Task** from Morvran/Laniakea for a +14% damage and accuracy bonus.
* **Combat Tactics**:
  * Use **Conjure Undead Army** prior to entering or spawning Kree'arra.
  * Necromancy bypasses Kree'arra's traditional Ranged/Magic soft-caps, dealing massive burst damage via [Invoke Death](https://runescape.wiki/w/Invoke_Death) and [Finger of Death](https://runescape.wiki/w/Finger_of_Death).
  * Keep *Protect from Ranged* active and stand in melee range or leverage the [Ghost Conjure](https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Putrid_Ghost) for continuous passive healing, drastically reducing the need for food.
  * For full gear setups and rotation advice, review the official [Kree'arra Boss Strategy Guide](https://runescape.wiki/w/Kree%27arra/Strategies).

---

### 📋 Actionable Next Steps

1. **Ritual Site Setup**: Load your ritual altar with maximum level Multiply Glyphs and process your stored Lesser/Greater Necroplasm into [Powerful Necroplasm](https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerful_necroplasm).
2. **Finish Remaining Quests**: Complete [Alpha and Omega](https://runescape.wiki/w/Alpha_and_Omega) to officially finish all Necromancy quest requirements.
3. **Slayer Task Rolling**: Grab an Aviansie task to utilize your [Full Slayer Helmet](https://runescape.wiki/w/Full_slayer_helmet) at [Kree'arra](https://runescape.wiki/w/Kree%27arra) for fast combat/Slayer XP towards 120 Necromancy.
4. **Invention Synergy**: Augment your Tier 70+ Necromancy weapons/armor to gain passive [Invention](https://runescape.wiki/w/Invention) XP while training Necromancy combat.

OK, I'm making powerful necroplasms en masse - I have 3 glyphs spare for alterations - I have two multiply 3s and one attraction 2 - is this good, should I change? My cape is multiply. My goal is maximal necroplasms output

**Change it!** Swap out the **Attraction II** glyph for a **Multiply III** glyph. If your goal is **maximal Powerful Necroplasm output**, **[Attraction glyphs](https://runescape.wiki/w/Attraction_III)** do **not** help you. Attraction only increases the chance of random disturbance events (which give massive XP/soul yield), but it provides **0% extra item output**. **[Multiply glyphs](https://runescape.wiki/w/Multiply_III)** are what directly multiply your base Necroplasm production. Since your **Necromancy level is 106**, you already have **Multiply III** fully unlocked (requires Level 103 Necromancy). --- ### 📊 Setup Yield Comparison Base output for a [Powerful Necroplasm Ritual](https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerful_necroplasm_ritual) is **20 Powerful Necroplasms** per ritual. | Setup | Alteration Glyphs Used | Cape Bonus | Total Multiplier | Necroplasm Output Per Ritual | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Your Current Setup** | 2x Multiply III (+120%)
1x Attraction II (+0%) | Necromancy Cape (+20%) | **+140%** (2.4x) | **48 Necroplasms** | | **Recommended Setup** | **3x Multiply III (+180%)** | Necromancy Cape (+20%) | **+200%** (3.0x) | **60 Necroplasms** | --- ### ⚔️ Optimization Breakdown & Strategy * **Why replace Attraction II?** * Attraction increases disturbance spawn rate for training XP. But for pure material farming, it takes up a valuable alteration spot that could be adding another **+60% output**! * **How Multiply & Cape Stack**: * Multiply III = **+60%** yield per glyph * [Necromancy Skillcape](https://runescape.wiki/w/Necromancy_cape) = **+20%** yield (acts as a permanent passive Multiply I) * With 3x Multiply III + Skillcape equipped, your total bonus output reaches **+200%**, giving you **3x the base material yield** on every single ritual completion! --- ### 📋 Recommended Action Items 1. **Erase the Attraction II glyph** from your ritual platform. 2. **Draw a Multiply III glyph** in its place (requires basic/regular/robust inks depending on tier). 3. **Ensure your Necromancy Cape is equipped** or stored in your Anachronia Skillcape Stand to retain the passive +20% bonus. 4. **Maintain Glyph Repair**: Keep an eye on your glyph durabilities so you don't lose the bonus mid-session! This change alone boosts your yield from **48 to 60 Powerful Necroplasms per ritual**, accelerating your progress toward your **120 Necromancy** goal while stocking up massive supplies!

Greetings, **RozRaid**! 

Looking at your impressive profile—Combat 134, a towering **106 Necromancy**, 95 Slayer, and 240 completed quests—you are well on your way to endgame dominance. Based on your current stats, favorite boss target (**Kree'arra**), and active To-Do objectives, I have engineered a tailored set of short-, mid-, and long-term goals to maximize your progression.

---

### ⚔️ Goal 1: Execute Your Active Necromancy Roadmap
*(Immediate Focus / Active To-Do List)*

You're already making massive gains in Necromancy (106 and climbing). Let's turn that momentum into optimal setup efficiency:

*   **10k+ Powerful Necroplasm Stockpile**: Utilize the [Powerful Communion Ritual](https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerful_communion_ritual) at the [City of Um](https://runescape.wiki/w/City_of_Um) ritual site. Focus on maximizing attraction percentage with your highest available alteration glyphs (Multiply/Speed) to optimize your Necroplasm yields.
*   **Complete Necromancy Questlines**: Finish any remaining Necromancy quests like [Alpha vs Omega](https://runescape.wiki/w/Alpha_vs_Omega) to unlock high-tier combat abilities, gear upgrades, and full power over the Underworld.
*   **Path to 120 Necromancy**: Balance high-tier combat slayer tasks with high-exp ritual setups (using [Powerful Alteration Rituals](https://runescape.wiki/w/Rituals)) to hit 104M XP efficiently.
*   **Wiki Reference**: See the [Necromancy Training Guide](https://runescape.wiki/w/Necromancy_training) for optimal ritual tile layouts.

---

### 📜 Goal 2: Unlock Prifddinas ([Plague's End](https://runescape.wiki/w/Plague%27s_End))
*(Major Milestone)*

You are tantalizingly close to completing [Plague's End](https://runescape.wiki/w/Plague%27s_End) and unlocking the elven city of **Prifddinas**, the ultimate high-level hub for training, skilling, and high-tier utility. Out of the 10 skill requirements at level 75, **you already satisfy 8 of them!**

| Required Skill | Your Current Level | Level Required | Status |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |

#### Action Items:
1.  **Construction (74 ➔ 75)**: Build a single flatpack or room fixture in your POH to gain 1 level instantly.
2.  **Dungeoneering (64 ➔ 75)**: Run floor rushes or participate in daily [Sinkholes](https://runescape.wiki/w/Sinkholes) minigames to knock out 11 levels fast.
3.  **Complete Quest**: Finish [Plague's End](https://runescape.wiki/w/Plague%27s_End) to unlock Prifddinas.

---

### 🦅 Goal 3: Boss Optimization for [Kree'arra](https://runescape.wiki/w/Kree%27arra) & PvM
*(Combat Progression)*

To melt **Kree'arra** in God Wars Dungeon 1 faster and sustain longer solo trips, target these critical combat support upgrades:

*   **Raise Prayer to 95**: Unlocks top-tier [Ancient Curses](https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_Curses) such as [Soul Split](https://runescape.wiki/w/Soul_Split) (level 92) for passive healing and [Sorrow](https://runescape.wiki/w/Sorrow) (level 95) for maximum Necromancy boosting.
*   **Raise Herblore to 96**: Unlocks tradable/untradable [Overload](https://runescape.wiki/w/Overload) potions. Overloads negate status drains and apply massive static stat boosts for the duration of boss encounters.
*   **Supercharge Invention (48 ➔ 80+)**: Level your Invention by augmenting your weapons/armor while leveling Necromancy or doing Slayer tasks. Disassemble/siphon level 10+ items to unlock high-end PvM perks like *Biting*, *Precise*, and *Equilibrium*. Check out the [Invention Training Guide](https://runescape.wiki/w/Invention_training) for fast XP paths.

---

### 📋 Strategic Priority Summary

```
[1] Finish 1 level of Construction (75) & 11 levels of Dungeoneering (75)
       ↓
[2] Complete 'Plague's End' Quest to unlock Prifddinas
       ↓
[3] Grind 'Powerful Communion Rituals' for >10k Powerful Necroplasm & 120 Necro
       ↓
[4] Push Herblore (96 Overloads) & Prayer (95 Curses) for Kree'arra Dominance
```
